# The History of Communion and Worship Claim Audit

Support the primary activity for T5-L19 - The History of Communion and Worship.

## Use
- Lesson: T5-L19 - The History of Communion and Worship
- Big idea: Early and later practices illuminate interpretation while explicit text, pattern, and tradition remain distinct categories.
- Primary reading: Acts 20:7; 1 Corinthians 11:17-34; selected historical sources

## Evidence moves
1. Record direct observations.
2. Mark interpretation or canonical synthesis separately.
3. For historical claims, record the external source and confidence level.
4. State one faithful response without upgrading inference into explicit text.

## Publication hold
Do not publish post-biblical historical claims until the relevant primary source packet has been verified and cited.
